info.title: uploads.sh API
info.description: Workspace-scoped file hosting for agents and humans. The canonical public hierarchy is `/v1/workspaces/{workspace}/...`. Full narrative docs: https://github.com/buildinternet/uploads/blob/main/docs/api.md

tags.name: Maintenance
tags.description: Advanced workspace operations that can scan or delete stored objects.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: Pull requests, repos and files grouped by GitHub context.

get.description: Returns one page (up to 50) of the public newest-first item list for a feed, plus `nextCursor` for the next page. It omits workspace ownership and object keys. Items are resolved at view time from `gh.repo` and optional `gh.number` metadata.

200.description: The public feed, one page of items, and live PR state.

get.description: Returns the public allowlisted projection. It omits workspace ownership and object keys.

200.description: The public gallery and its public item projection.

parameters.name: delimiter
parameters.description: Return common prefixes for folder-style navigation.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Pass `0` to skip metadata on each item.

200.description: A page of files and an opaque continuation cursor.

get.description: Requires at least one `meta.<key>` equality filter or a `name` substring. Metadata filter names are dynamic query parameters.

parameters.name: collapse
parameters.description: Drop branch originals that were promoted to a PR copy.

200.description: A bounded page. `truncated` is true and `cursor` is non-null when more matches remain; pass `cursor` back to continue.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: When present, list values for this metadata key. Otherwise list keys.

200.description: Metadata key facets or value facets.

get.summary: Group workspace files by GitHub path
get.description: Powers the web Screenshots page's grouped-by-path view. Groups recently uploaded `gh.*`-tagged files by project and path. Files with a `screen` and no `path` group by screen name, marked `by: "screen"`.

parameters.name: merged
parameters.description: Set to `1` to include only files tagged from a merged PR.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Keep only files of this type, by key extension.

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Keep only files the classifier labeled with this device (`ai.surface`).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Keep only files uploaded in the last N days (1d to 365d).

200.description: Path groups, a flat catalog, known projects, and a flat recent feed.

get.summary: Resolve a usable URL for a file
get.description: Returns the workspace's public URL when configured, otherwise a short-lived signed download URL. Resolves across storage lanes so a file uploaded before a storage switch still resolves.
Keys held for approval, optionally under one key prefix. A held file on hosted storage is moved out of the public bucket, so the file list does not show it.

area.description: Flagged region as fractions of the image, when known.

get.summary: Download a held file for review
get.description: Streams the held copy as an attachment. 404 when the file has no held copy.

post.summary: Release a file held for review
post.description: The classifier holds a file that likely shows a secret or sensitive personal data. A held file is left out of the managed PR comment, public feeds, galleries, and its file page until a member approves it. A key that is not held answers 200 with `approved: false`.

post.summary: Hold an approved file for review again
post.description: For a file approved by mistake: puts it back under review, so its link stops working until a member approves it again. Only a file that was held and approved can be held again; any other key answers 200 with `held: false`.

200.description: Whether the file is held again.

get.description: Whether a file is held, was approved (with who approved it and when), or was never held. For workspace members; the public file API does not return it.

put.description: Send an Idempotency-Key to make retries safe for 24 hours. Reusing the key with the same effective request (keyed on the uploaded content) returns the original 201 response. Reusing it with a different request returns 409.

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: Allow replacement. `X-Uploads-Replace: 1` is an equivalent header form.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Validate and resolve the final key without writing.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present with value `true` when the API replays a stored response.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Return only the queryable metadata map.

200.description: Object metadata, or a metadata-only response when requested.
Usage counters, configured limits, credential scopes, and plan.

post.description: Potentially expensive: scans every object in the workspace's active storage lanes and rebuilds the usage ledger. Requires a bearer token with `files:write`; browser sessions are not accepted.

post.summary: Purge files past the retention window
post.description: Destructive: permanently deletes objects older than the workspace's `retentionDays`, then reconciles usage. Requires a bearer token with `files:delete`; browser sessions are not accepted. The response is either `{ skipped: true }` or a purge and reconciliation result.

200.description: Purge result, or `skipped` when retention does not apply.

post.description: Send an Idempotency-Key to make retries safe for 24 hours. Reusing the key with the same effective body returns the original 201 response. Reusing it with a different body returns 409.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present with value `true` when the API replays a stored response.

200.description: Enriched gallery summaries and an opaque continuation cursor.

get.description: PRs in this workspace with uploads, newest media first. By default only PRs with media in the last 90 days; pass `all=1` for every PR or `since` for a custom window. `type` and `surface` narrow the thumbnails, not the list.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only media uploaded in the last N days, `1d` to `365d`.

get.description: Repos with GitHub-tagged uploads. `since` narrows the list; `type` and `surface` narrow the thumbnails. `thumbnails=0` returns names only.

parameters.description: Only media uploaded in the last N days, `1d` to `365d`.

get.description: Newest-first files tagged to a repo, or to one PR or issue with `number`.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only media uploaded in the last N days, `1d` to `365d`.

post.summary: Create or update the managed PR comment
post.description: Renders this workspace's files and galleries for a PR or issue and posts or updates the uploads.sh comment as the GitHub App. Call it once after uploading. Bearer token only.

get.description: Public details for one file. Private and held files return 404. `download=1` streams the bytes as an attachment instead.

200.description: File details, or the bytes with `download=1`.

get.description: Streams the item as an attachment. Items that are missing, private or held return 404.
One item with its neighbours, for paging through a feed.

200.description: The item and its position in the feed.

FileKey.name: key
FileKey.description: Object key. It may include slashes.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A caller-scoped retry key retained for 24 hours. Use 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters.

Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

Forbidden.description: The credential lacks the required scope or role.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with current resource state.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The upload exceeds the workspace limit.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The bytes are not an allowed media type.

RateLimited.description: The workspace rate limit or upload budget was exceeded.

pageUrl.description: Public `/f/` page. Listing only, when the file has a public URL.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation for the next page, or null on the last page.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the signed URL expires. Capped at 900 for SVG and XML content types (issue #929).

holdCheck.description: Present when the classifier may still hold this file for review. It decides after the response.

storageBudgetBasis.description: Which byte count the storage cap applies to. `shared` for a workspace on its own bucket, where only hosted residue is metered.

number.description: Optional pull request or issue number. Filters on gh.number.

kind.description: Display-only. Set automatically when you pass pr or issue.

pr.description: Alias for number with kind=pull. Mutually exclusive with number and issue.

issue.description: Alias for number with kind=issue. Mutually exclusive with number and pr.

source.description: Who created the feed: PR comment sync or a user. Null for feeds created before this field.

usage.description: Usage after reconciling, in the `Usage` shape minus `scopes`, `plan` and `storage`.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the signed target expires.

upload.description: Send the bytes here: a PUT with `headers`, or a multipart POST with `fields`.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next 50 items, or null on the last page.

github.description: Live PR or issue title and state, public repos only. Null for a repo-wide feed.

total.description: Items in the feed's scope, capped at 2,000.

metadata.description: Public metadata. Internal and `ai.*` labels are removed.

counterpart.description: The other half of a before/after pair, when it is public.

privateCount.description: Private files in the scope, first page only. Null on later pages or when counting would be too costly.

liveLink.description: The existing public feed for exactly this scope.

resync.description: Force a full search for the managed comment instead of the cached id.

held.description: Files on the PR or issue held for review.

GithubCommentResult.description: Integration problems never return 5xx. `posted: false` carries the reason so callers can fall back.

bearerAuth.description: Workspace token from `uploads login` or `/account/developers`. Canonical routes can also accept an uploads.sh browser session, but public API integrations should use a workspace token. Tokens carry named scopes `files:read`, `files:write`, and `files:delete`; each operation lists the required scope as a role name on this scheme. REST v1 does not accept OAuth access tokens (those are for the hosted MCP). Scope catalog: https://api.uploads.sh/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

oauth2.description: Named permission scopes for workspace tokens (this API) and for OAuth 2.1 access tokens on the hosted MCP at https://agents.uploads.sh/mcp. REST v1 authenticates with `bearerAuth` only. Request the scopes listed on each operation. Discovery: https://uploads.sh/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server and https://api.uploads.sh/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource

scopes.files:read: List, search, read metadata, usage, galleries, and feeds.
scopes.files:write: Upload, update metadata, galleries, feeds, and usage reconcile.
scopes.files:delete: Delete stored objects and purge expired objects.
